sentences.text:
Brahm Pal & Ors vs State & Anr on 21 April, 2023
$~12
* In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
+ Crl.M.C. 5617/2018
 Brahm Pal & Ors.

entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
..... Petitioners
 Through: Mr. Jagjit Singh, Mr. Preet Singh, Mr.
 Tushar Choudhary and Mr. Kalyani
 Arora, Advocates.

Respondents
 Through: Mr. Ritesh Kumar Bahri, App for the
 State with Si Nakul, Ps: Mahendra
 Park.

Ms. Subhauana and Mr. Priyaram,
 Advocates.

Mr. S.K. Verma, Advocate for
 respondent.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal

Pursuant to the previous order dated 10th March, 2023, learned counsel for the respondent No.2 as well as respondent No. 2 is present in person and confirms that they have received about Rs.2.5 lacs as per the settlement and also the stridhan from bank locker of the Punjab National Bank Muzzafarnagar U.P.
2.

Further, it is further confirmed that there is no aspect of the settlement dated 13th September,
2017 which needs to be complied with.

3. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Consequently, the FIR No. 164/2016 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Mahendra Park and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
4. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
5. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
6. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.

ANISH DAYAL, J APRIL 21, 2023/RK Brahm Pal & Ors vs State & Anr on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25848411/
